items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: And we played for various entertainers... Harry Watson was a leader... His brother, Eddie, played guitar.

ctx.x: Do you remember who played that then? Did you?
They all did. Eddie Watson, Harry Watson, a fellow playing bass named Murray. And another Watson playing banjoes. Stringes. No horns.
Who got the band together? Can you remember a little bit over there?

items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, he studied under that Watson fellow.

ctx.x: Yes, I sang on a record. I think it was one of Joe Moray's records. Dr. Sushan. Dr. Sushan had that session, yes.
You know, he studied under that Watson fellow. Who did? Dr. Sushan. Who did? Dr. Sushan. He did. Eddie watched the other day?
